subject: Gate results for arm X (bootstrap probe) and arm AA (ACTION7 -> UNDO). Both TIE on levels; neither promoted. Arm AA's MECHANISM is confirmed repaired and the fix is carried forward as maintenance, not as a promotion.
control: q38-temp09-v1, the bundle that drew our banked 2.65: 35 levels, 4 zero-level games

arm_X_bootstrap_probe.MECHANISM_GATE: PARTIAL. taaf_setup_env.json shows BOOTSTRAP_PROBE=1, BOOTSTRAP_PROBE_CAP=6, so the overlay was live. But whole-game action-class coverage did NOT improve: 2 of 25 games still end with an offered-but-never-played class, the same as the arm without the probe.
arm_X_bootstrap_probe.why_the_effect_is_invisible: The 40-percent-uncovered figure that motivated this arm was measured on LEVEL 1 ONLY. Across a whole game the agent already covers ~92 percent of offered classes unaided, so a probe capped at 6 actions and firing only on untried classes at level start has very little left to do. The arm is not broken; the headroom was smaller than the level-1 statistic implied.
arm_X_bootstrap_probe.VERDICT: TIE band, sign test slightly against. Incumbent keeps the slot. NOT PROMOTED.
arm_X_bootstrap_probe.note_on_convergent_discovery: The top-of-board polyphony bundle calls its own bootstrap probe load-bearing, but probes EVERY class at EVERY level start with probe_cap 12, against our gap-filling probe capped at 6. Our result bounds the gap-filling form only; it says nothing about theirs.

arm_AA_undo_action.paired_sign_test: 3 gained / 2 lost, which is not separation

mechanism_evidence.undo_offered_in: exactly 6 of 25 games, matching the documented '6 of the 25 public games expose it' with no tuning
mechanism_evidence.undo_EXECUTED: 2 times in this arm, against 0 in the arm run the same night on the unpatched map, and 0 in 68,682 recorded actions historically
mechanism_evidence.batch_rejections: 'Unknown action' fell from 28 (unpatched arm, same night) to 4. A 7x reduction. Each rejection discarded a WHOLE batch, so this recovered valid actions too, not only the undo.

arm_AA_undo_action.VERDICT: TIE on levels (35 vs 35). The predeclared gate says ties go to the incumbent and forbids promoting on a variance argument. NOT PROMOTED into the rotation.
arm_AA_undo_action.BUT_THE_FIX_IS_CARRIED_FORWARD: This is a maintenance decision, explicitly separate from the gate. The gate exists to stop noise being promoted as capability, and no capability claim is being made: the level totals are identical. What is established is that a code path which advertised an action and then rejected the entire batch containing it is now repaired, at zero measured cost and with one fewer zero-level game. Every future bundle, including the polyphony port, applies apply_undo_action.py.
arm_AA_undo_action.a_finding_we_could_not_have_had_before: With the action reachable, the model still chose it only twice. THAT is the genuine 'the model rarely uses undo' result. The old 0-of-68,682 figure was not evidence of preference, because the action could not execute at all.
arm_AA_undo_action.loose_end: 4 'Unknown action' rejections remain in this arm. Not diagnosed. Likely the model inventing action names outside the map; worth one grep before any future action-space change.

the_pattern_now_at_seven_arms: Arms V, W, Y, Z, X and AA have all landed inside the noise floor of the 25-game bench, and arms Y, Z and AA had CONFIRMED working mechanisms. Harness-level overlays on this architecture are exhausted as a source of level gains. This is the empirical case for the polyphony port, and it is also a publishable result in its own right.
